name: Medico Intercontinental Limite
summary: Medico Intercontinental Ltd. primarily operates in the financial domain, engaging in the provision of capital, active market trading, and strategic investments in equities and debt instruments. The firm extends its services to a diverse range of sectors, including manufacturing, commerce, construction, and various other service-based enterprises. This assistance is rendered through financial loans and by supplying assets such as capital, equipment, real estate, buildings, and industrial facilities. The company was established on August 14, 1984, and its corporate headquarters are situated in Ahmedabad, India.
